briefdescription.para: Upper triangle of the Hessian, row by row.
Position of the Hessian entry ( i, j ) in the stored upper triangle.
Calls f( i ) for every direction i in a mask.
Index of the diagonal entry ( i, i ) in the stored upper triangle, where row i starts.

Calls f( i, k ) for every k of row i of the stored upper triangle, i.e., the entries ( i, j ), j >= i, for all directions i in a mask; the rows of the other directions do not change in the operations.

parameterdescription.para: function of the row direction and the Hessian index; the column is j = i + k - rowStart( i )

briefdescription.para: Creates the result of an operation that depends on the directions in a mask: uninitialized if all directions, since the operation writes all entries then, and zero otherwise, since it writes only the entries of the rows in the mask.

simplesect.para: the number, with the mask set

briefdescription.para: Creates a number with uninitialized gradient and Hessian, for the implementation of the operations, which must write all entries.

Makes this number the independent variable direction (gradient = unit vector, zero Hessian).
Sets the directions this number depends on, for the implementation of the operations.

briefdescription.para: Second-order vector-mode number: value, gradient and Hessian with respect to nDirections_ variables.

detaileddescription.para:
nDirections_
number of independent variables (directions)
The Hessian is stored as its upper triangle, row by row. The gradient and the Hessian precede the value, so that pairs of them are 16-byte aligned for SIMD.
The mask holds the directions the number depends on; the gradient and Hessian entries of all other directions are zero.
